stem.t: Consider the following pseudocode for depth-first

search (DFS) algorithm which takes a directed
graph G(V,E) as input, where d[v] and f[v] are the
discovery time and finishing time, respectively, of
the vertex v ∈V.

DFS(G)  :            Explore ( G, v, t ):
  unmark all v ∈ V     mark v
  t ← 0                t ← t + 1
  for each v ∈ V       d[v] ← t
   if v is unmarked   for each (v, w) ∈ E
     t ← Explore        if w is unmarked
( G, v, t )                t ← Explore (G, w, t)
   end if               end if
  end for              end for

t ← t + 1
f[v] ← t
return t
